defs.def: of poorer quality or lower standard; less good or more unpleasant 更差的；更糟的；更坏的

ex.s: She says it is essential that we keep control of artificial intelligence, or risk being sidelined and perhaps even worse.
ex.t: 她说，我们必须始终掌控人工智能，否则就有被边缘化甚至更糟的风险。

ex.s: For better or worse, ALife mirrors the very subject it studies.
ex.t: 无论好坏，ALife反映了它所研究的对象本身。

ex.s: Why is Ms Raspopova’s husband “the worse page turner”?
ex.t: 为什么拉斯波波娃女士的丈夫是"最糟糕的翻谱员"？

ex.s: It will get worse with human interference.
ex.t: 他们的研究还提出了即使突触变薄了我们如何随时间建立持久记忆的问题。

defs.def: more serious or severe 更严重的；更严厉的

ex.s: These developments are likely to make our current problems with robocalls much worse.
ex.t: 这些新的发展事态很可能使我们当前面临的机器人电话问题变得更加严重。

ex.s: As his hearing got worse and worse, doctors sent him to the village of Heiligenstadt, near Vienna, in the hope that he would recover.
ex.t: 随着他的听力越来越差，医生们把他送到维也纳附近的海利根施塔特村，希望他能康复。

defs.def: more ill/sick or unhappy 病情更重；健康恶化；更不愉快

ex.s: They first found 10 overweight and inactive but otherwise healthy young men, whose lifestyles are, for better and worse, representative of those of most of us.
ex.t: 他们首先找到了10名超重且不爱运动但其他方面健康的年轻男性，他们的生活方式无论好坏都代表了我们大多数人的生活方式。

defs.def: less well 更坏；更差；更糟

ex.s: “But if we’re not careful, we could make air quality worse.”
ex.t: “但如果我们不够谨慎，反而可能让空气质量变得更糟。”

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: But however long it takes, the technology has the potential to change our transportation systems and our cities, for better or for worse, depending on how the transformation is regulated.
ex.t: 但无论需要多长时间，这项技术都有潜力改变我们的交通系统和城市，无论是变得更好还是更糟，这取决于这种转型如何被监管。

ex.s: It strengthened people's long held idea of the great white shark as a dangerous animal.People have always been scared of sharks, but Jaws made things worse.
ex.t: 这强化了人们长期以来认为大白鲨是危险动物的看法。人们一直害怕鲨鱼，但《大白鲨》让情况变得更糟。

ex.s: Tell your friend you’re angry with him for repeating what you said and making the situation worse, but that you want to move on.
ex.t: 告诉你的朋友，你很生他的气，因为他重复了你的话，使情况变得更糟，但你想继续前进。

ex.s: Yet the problem, by just about any measure, appears to be getting worse.
ex.t: 然而，无论从哪个标准看，这个问题似乎都在变得更糟。

ex.s: Needless to say, I didn't look forward to an entire term of being brushed off, but I tried to make the best of it and didn't say anything for fear that I would make things worse.
ex.t: 不用说，我并不期待整整一学期都被冷落，但我尽量随遇而安，什么也没说，怕把事情弄得更糟。

defs.def: more seriously or severely 更严重；更厉害

ex.s: Even worse, I had unthinkingly bought way too much; I could have made six salads with what I threw out.
ex.t: 更糟糕的是，我不小心买了太多；我用扔掉的那些本来可以做六份沙拉。

ex.s: What’s worse, I then spent so much time catching up on news, I almost missed the party!
ex.t: 更糟糕的是，我随后花了太多时间浏览新闻，差点错过了聚会！

ex.s: We’ve all been there: in a lift, in line at the bank or on an airplane, surrounded by people who are, like us, deeply focused on their smartphones or, worse, struggling with the uncomfortable silence.
ex.t: 我们都经历过这样的情况：在电梯里、在银行排队或在飞机上，周围的人像我们一样全神贯注地看着智能手机，或者更糟的是，在不舒服的沉默中挣扎。

defs.def: in a poor condition because of being used a lot 用旧的；用坏的

ex.s: The situation here is so much worse because the “loose lips” were your best friend’s.
ex.t: 这里的情况要糟糕得多，因为“松开的嘴唇”是你最好的朋友的。
